changelog:
- Initial release: Easily generate AI videos using Kuaishou Kling via AceDataCloud API.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, video extension, and motion control workflows.
- Multiple video models and quality modes available for different speed, cost, and quality needs.
- Authentication via ACEDATACLOUD_API_TOKEN environment variable required.
- Clear documentation for endpoints, parameters, and usage examples provided.
